summary: Live operational reporting and Smart Insights for the Dukora Lenovo test release.
notes: Connected dashboard KPIs, payment mix, top sellers, activity, expenses and reports to PostgreSQL records.
Added Smart Insights with an offline rule engine and optional privacy-conscious LLM integration.

Rebranded the product and Windows installer as Dukora.
Integrated the transparent Dukora icon and Smarter Business Operations tagline.
Added PostgreSQL-backed organization, branch and terminal configuration.
Added 58 mm and 80 mm receipt layouts with configurable fields and print policies.
Added native Windows installation profile while preserving Docker deployment.
Added version display, update checks, logout, themes and collapsible navigation.
Added institution, outlet, terminal and shared API configuration.
Bundled the verified Xprinter receipt-driver installer.
